source: Positions from NASA/JPL Mars 2020 MMGIS waypoints and traverse (mars.nasa.gov/mmgis-maps/M20), sample list from science.nasa.gov/mission/mars-2020-perseverance/mars-rock-samples
coordinates: xM/yM = metres from the map's north-west corner (x east, y south); eastM/northM = metres from the landing site; lon/lat = Mars 2000 planetocentric, east longitude

pois.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing
pois.note: Perseverance touchdown, Feb 18 2021 (sol 0). Position = first localisation, sol 13.

pois.name: Wright Brothers Field (Ingenuity airfield)
pois.note: Ingenuity was dropped here around sol 43 and made the first powered flight on another planet on sol 58 (Apr 19 2021). Position = rover position on the deployment sol, within ~50 m.

pois.name: Descent stage crash site
pois.note: The sky crane flew away after lowering the rover and crashed ~700 m north-west, leaving a V-shaped debris pattern.
pois.positionSource: HiRISE ESP_068294_1985 annotated release (uahirise.org/releases/perseverance), registered by hand

pois.name: Parachute and backshell
pois.note: The 21.5 m parachute and the backshell landed together ~1.1 km west-north-west. Ingenuity photographed the backshell standing upright on flight 26 (sol 418).
pois.positionSource: HiRISE ESP_068294_1985 annotated release (uahirise.org/releases/perseverance), registered by hand

pois.name: Heat shield impact
pois.note: Jettisoned during descent, the heat shield hit the ground ~1.5 km east-north-east.
pois.positionSource: HiRISE ESP_068294_1985 annotated release (uahirise.org/releases/perseverance), registered by hand

pois.name: Three Forks Sample Depot
pois.note: Ten sample tubes (9 rock/regolith/atmosphere + 1 witness tube) were dropped here between sol 653 and 690 (Dec 21 2022 - Jan 28 2023) as a backup cache for Mars Sample Return.
